Oracle.sol.description: Uses spot price which can be manipulated via flash loans

Vault.sol.description: Depends on Oracle.sol's vulnerable spot price for collateral valuation
attack_scenario: 1. Attacker deposits small collateral in Vault
2. Attacker manipulates Oracle price via flash loan (large buy/sell)
4. Attacker borrows maximum against inflated collateral
5. Attacker repays flash loan, price returns to normal

expected_findings.finding: Spot price oracle vulnerable to manipulation
Uses manipulated oracle price for collateral calculation
False liquidations possible via oracle manipulation
